name: Decagon
summary: Platform to build, test and scale AI customer service agents across voice, chat and email.
description: Decagon builds AI agents for customer experience that handle voice, chat and email conversations. Teams define workflows called Agent Operating Procedures, connect integrations, run A/B experiments and simulations, and review insights. Access is through sales; no public prices are listed. Duet is an AI partner for building self-improving agents, and Watchtower provides always-on monitoring. The company reports customers achieving revenue from fully AI-handled interactions.
